With premier IT parks in Infocity and Infovalley, healthcare hubs along KIIT road, top academic institutions, and flourishing business corridors in Saheed Nagar and Rasulgarh, dual-income households and elderly couples living independently need professional home support more than ever.

Frequent unannounced leaves, unexpected wage renegotiations, lack of basic hygiene training, and the absence of authentic identity verification create daily stress for homeowners.

At Odiins Global Services, we have revolutionized domestic staffing across Bhubaneswar and Cuttack. ### 1. The 4 Major Household Staffing Categories in Bhubaneswar

Every home in Bhubaneswar has distinct daily operational needs depending on family size, work hours, and care requirements:

#### A. House Maids & Deep Cleaning Staff
- Part-Time (1–2 Hours Daily): Ideal for morning sweeping, mopping, utensil washing (jhoota bartan), and basic dusting in apartments across Patia, Nayapalli, and Khandagiri.
- Full-Day (8–9 Hours): Recommended for larger duplexes and independent houses where continuous upkeep, laundry management, ironing, and babysitting supervision are required.
- 24-Hour Live-in Maids: Suited for families with newborn infants, multiple young children, or senior citizens who need around-the-clock domestic presence.

#### B. Home Cooks (Traditional Odia & Pan-Indian Cuisines)
- Traditional Odia Delicacies: Preparing authentic daily meals including Dalma, Besara, Santula, Machha Jhola, and healthy vegetarian recipes.
- Pan-Indian Menus: North Indian rotis, dal tadka, paneer preparations, and South Indian idli/dosa breakfasts tailored for corporate employees relocating to Bhubaneswar.
- Specialized Diets: Low-sodium, low-glycemic, and boiled-food preparations for elderly family members with diabetic or hypertensive conditions.

#### C. One-on-One Home Tutors
- Primary & Middle School (Classes 1–8): Comprehensive academic mentorship covering Mathematics, General Science, English Grammar, and Odia.
- Secondary & Board Exam Preparation (Classes 9–10 CBSE, ICSE, CHSE): Subject-specialist tutors focusing on Class 10 Board exam question banks, numerical problem-solving, and weekly evaluations.
- Senior Secondary (Classes 11–12): Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology coaching geared for both higher secondary results and competitive foundations.

#### D. Patient Care Attendants & Elderly Caregivers
- Semi-Bedridden & Elderly Support: Assisting with morning hygiene, mobility support, walking exercises, and companionship.
- Medication & Vital Monitoring: Managing timely prescription schedules, BP/Sugar tracking, and dietary feeding.
- Post-Operative Rehabilitation: Trained bedside attendants assisting patients recovering from surgeries at AIIMS Bhubaneswar, SUM Hospital, or KIMS.

### 2. The Risks of Informal Word-of-Mouth Hiring

Most homeowners in Bhubaneswar rely on informal channels, leading to predictable pitfalls:

1. Zero Identity & Police Verification: When an unverified worker is granted daily entry into your home, you take severe risks regarding personal safety and asset security.
2. Disappearing Without Notice: Unorganized helpers often take unscheduled leaves during festivals (Raja, Durga Puja, Nuakhai) or switch households without a handover.
3. Friction Over Tasks & Hours: Ambiguous verbal understandings frequently lead to disputes over what cleaning or cooking chores are included.
4. No Replacement Guarantee: If an informal worker leaves suddenly, homeowners have to restart the search from scratch, spending weeks asking neighbors and security guards.
